purpose: Authorize offline P2-derived model-side semantics for the current 20 R2 development BPMN files without rewriting or broadening the original P2 whitelist or claiming that the original P2 formal run covered these files.

original_p2.note: R3 imports and calls the frozen implementation; it does not edit the P2 config whitelist or re-run the original P2 formal inference.

r3_authorized_inputs.claim_boundary: This authorizes offline derivation for the current R2 development corpus only. It is not an independent test set, not a re-run of the original P2 formal evaluation, and not evidence that P2 was trained or validated on these files.

required_evidence.extension_note: The original P2 sidecar covered activities only. R3 extends the same frozen label analysis to named events.
